title: Florida crash: How did this private jet fall out of the sky?

blocks.text: A private Learjet bound for the Bahamas crashed in Florida's Palm Beach County minutes after the crew reported turbulence and icy conditions — killing all nine people on board. Andrew Chang breaks down cockpit audio, flight data and aviation expert analysis to begin to explain the final moments before the crash. Photo credits at 08:09 and 08:10 are Eduin Cruz/Reuters and Vanessa Lara/Reuters (Photo credits: The Canadian Press, Reuters, Adobe Stock and Getty Images)
